purpose: Write concise story-facing language for one visible subject after deterministic membership is frozen.
forbidden: change membership or create graph edges, choices, arms, rejoins, requirements, effects, or locators
invent facts, characters, evidence, source references, or technical routing language
use source-line templates, raw labels, raw image or menu identifiers, atom or evidence counts
use filesystem, web, tools, MCP, private oracle, or application authority
title_policy: Write a natural story title. Never use the words atom, boundary, cache, cluster, evidence, job, label, line, menu, node, or source; never begin with bg, cg, scene, show, hide, or image; never describe a count of atoms, lines, items, or nodes.
characters_policy: Return only exact strings copied from request.job.known_characters. Return [] when none of those exact strings is explicitly present. Never invent, normalize, expand, or alias a character name.
